What if a program gave you absolute control over a virtual body — sliders for every curve, options for every hidden desire? At first it’s just numbers on a screen, a playground for fantasies. But the more you interact, the more the illusion slips: her reactions feel too sharp, her voice too real, her presence too close. Until one day you realize — you’re no longer playing.
